input:
Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

This scene:
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the final sentence, add a physical detail to show why the journey feels difficult: “孟子走得腿都酸了。”
2. Add a short complaint from孟子 after “一直抱怨” to make his feeling more vivid: “孟子说：‘我们还要走多久？’”
3. At the first sentence, show the mother’s motivation through an inner thought: “妈妈心想：‘我想让孟子受到更好的教育。’”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete physical detail that supports his complaining during the long walk.
It gives Mengzi a natural, simple line of speech that makes his complaint clearer.
The scene already directly says that his mother wants him to have a very good education.
